description: Delete or remove by id — a PAGE and everything on it, or a BLOCK and everything in it (a layout included, with every block in its columns). This is how the blank page a document starts with goes, if you added your own pages instead of filling it. A document must keep at least one page, so removing the last one is refused; a page may be left empty — add its replacement afterwards rather than before.

id.description: A page id or a block id from get_document.

name: remove
title: Remove a page or a block
